import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('main.py')
text = p.read_text()
old = """    base=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    subprocess.run(['sh',str(base/'build.sh')],check=True)
    binary=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/workspace/tmp'))/'unit-merge-build/engine'
    result=subprocess.run([str(binary)],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()"""
new = """    base=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    subprocess.run(['sh',str(base/'build.sh')],check=True)
    tmp=os.environ.get('TMPDIR') or tempfile.gettempdir()
    binary=pathlib.Path(tmp)/'unit-merge-build/engine'
    result=subprocess.run([str(binary)],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()"""
assert old in text
text = text.replace(old, new)
text = text.replace("import json, math, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys", "import json, math, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile")
p.write_text(text)
print("ok")
